summary: Read one positive integer and write the spreadsheet column label that names it. Labels contain only uppercase English letters. The integer 1 writes A, 26 writes Z, 27 writes AA, and 28 writes AB. Larger integers follow the same base-26 letter counting, and you write the resulting letters. The value 701 must be handled and writes ZY. Write the letters alone, with no extra symbols or commentary. The input is a positive integer, never zero and never negative.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
